sources.title: Tripo P1 model card
sources.notes: Dedicated low-poly model P1-20260311. Does not support smart_low_poly, generate_parts, quad or geometry_quality. Use explicit per-asset limits; verify current availability before work.

sources.title: Tripo P-series image generation
sources.notes: V3 uses input and model. Image sources can be uploaded tokens or direct image URLs. PBR forces texturing. Retrieved revisions disagree on whether P2 is listed; recheck at execution.

sources.title: Tripo H-series generation
sources.notes: H3.1 supports smart_low_poly; set explicit face_limit. Prompt limit is documented as 1024 characters and negative_prompt as 255. Parts mode has incompatible options; do not combine it with this pack’s low-poly profile.

sources.title: Tripo P2 model card
sources.notes: P2-20260801 is listed as Preview in current search-indexed official content. It supports triangle/quad output and higher budgets; not the production default here. Page fetch was unavailable, so reconfirm full endpoint schema before opting in.

sources.title: Tripo CLI
sources.notes: Official CLI documents browser login, doctor, named production presets including game-mobile, and resumable batch workflows. Inspect installed help and resolved parameters rather than guessing extra flags.

sources.title: Tripo Codex plugin
sources.notes: Official indexed guide describes a Codex plugin that writes assets into the project, uses browser sign-in and expects confirmation for multi-model spending. Direct page fetch failed; availability in the user’s Codex environment remains unverified.

sources.title: Tripo task query
sources.notes: GET /v3/tasks/{task_id} exposes status, output and accounting fields. Keep task identifiers and download files after successful completion; task success is not art or engine acceptance.

sources.title: Tripo billing
sources.notes: V3 balance and usage are read-only account endpoints. Credit freezing, settlement and failures must be reconciled with actual account/task evidence; do not infer a spend allowance from balance.

sources.title: Tripo retopology
sources.notes: Retopology is POST /v3/mesh/decimate. Retrieved page lists v1/v2; newer indexed content adds v3 and smart_uv. This pack supplies no unverified v3 retopology payload; resolve the discrepancy live.

sources.title: Tripo conversion
sources.notes: POST /v3/models/convert supports FBX and texture-size controls. Conversion is distinct from topology repair. Preserve authoring masters and validate the result after DCC export.

sources.title: Tripo multiview P series
sources.notes: Multiview uses separate consistent views and documented view keys; front is required. The retrieved reference supports front/left/back/right. Do not feed a contact sheet as if it were one view.

sources.title: Tripo texture processing
sources.notes: Texturing is a separate model-processing task. Texture guidance modes have compatibility constraints. Reuse accepted geometry rather than creating new geometry to fix only color.

sources.title: Official Tripo MCP repository
sources.notes: The repository describes an alpha Blender-addon integration. This is not proof that the user’s installed connector exposes the current v3 schema or low-poly controls.

sources.title: Official Tripo JavaScript SDK
sources.notes: SDK targets the v3 API, unlike the legacy v2 task endpoint. It documents configurable retry behavior and short-lived output URLs; audit retries before enabling billable submissions.

sources.title: Roblox Importer
sources.notes: Importer documents FBX/glTF/OBJ and model hierarchies/PBR. Preserve the raw GLB as a source master; use a validated FBX or glTF delivery path, not a filename extension change.

sources.title: Roblox texture specifications
sources.notes: One material per mesh object and one UV set are documented, plus OpenGL tangent-space normal maps. Retrieved text gives 4K near the top but 1K in a later UV section; no universal platform maximum is asserted in this pack.

sources.title: Roblox performance guidance
sources.notes: Guidance covers render fidelity, collision simplification and scene costs. Use Automatic/Performance where suitable, reuse assets, and measure actual scene behavior rather than trusting polygon count alone.

sources.title: Codex MCP configuration
sources.notes: Official documentation redirects to ChatGPT Learn. codex mcp list lists configured MCP servers; /mcp shows active servers. A native plugin may not appear as an MCP entry.

sources.title: OpenAI documentation MCP
sources.notes: Official read-only documentation MCP is available for OpenAI/Codex product questions. It is not a Tripo API proxy and does not authenticate to Tripo.
